title: Translation Item Revision Contract
description: Translation items of a job (list, one item, dry-run replay of one item), single-block translation write-back and its revision history. Successful HTTP responses are wrapped in { code, message, data }; this schema describes the request body, data payloads, the revisions.v1.jsonl record and the structured error details. Validation runs the same Python review_translation_item checks used during translation (placeholders, inline math delimiters, English residue, protocol shells, glossary hints); only error-severity issues block a write. A successful write atomically rewrites the page payload, advances translation-checkpoint.v1.json (page_hash, generation, snapshot) and appends one record to translated/revisions.v1.jsonl. Rust then registers the revised pages in the live-translation read model (pipeline_units) and appends a pipeline_unit_committed event, served as translation_units_committed by live-events; see TranslationRevisionLivePublication.

endpoints.note: Items in page order, computed from translation-manifest.json and the current page files (so revisions and refine show up); old jobs without a manifest fall back to artifacts/translation_debug_index.json. A job that has not produced its translation manifest yet returns 200 with an empty list, not 404. Filters (page, final_status, error_type, route, q) apply before paging; total counts the filtered items.

errors.400: BAD_REQUEST: limit outside 1..=500, unknown query parameter
errors.404: NOT_FOUND: job does not exist (error.details is {})
NOT_FOUND: job or item does not exist (error.details is {}); no translation manifest yet: error.details.reason = not_ready, message "translation manifest not ready"

errors.400: BAD_REQUEST: oversized text/reason, malformed item id, unknown field in the request body
errors.404: NOT_FOUND: job or item does not exist (error.details is {}); no translation manifest yet: error.details.reason = not_ready, message "translation manifest not ready"
errors.422: TRANSLATION_REVISION_REJECTED: see TranslationRevisionErrorDetails.validation; UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY: request body does not match ReviseTranslationItemRequest (missing or unknown source)

endpoints.note: No request body (there is deliberately no input; send an empty body, any body is ignored). Runs backend/pipeline/devtools/replay_translation_item.py once in dry-run mode: the item is translated again with the job's saved settings and nothing is written back (to keep a replayed text, PATCH it). Synchronous, calls the model; the server gives up after 300 seconds.

errors.400: BAD_REQUEST: malformed item id (allowed: 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, - _ : .)
errors.404: NOT_FOUND: job or item does not exist (error.details is {}); no translation manifest yet: error.details.reason = not_ready
errors.409: TRANSLATION_REVISION_CONFLICT: error.details.reason = read_only_job for merged reading results (merged-...); replay the source job instead
errors.500: INTERNAL: replay script failed, timed out or printed something that is not JSON; error.details.error_id points at the server log

ListTranslationItemsQuery.description: views/common.rs :: ListTranslationItemsQuery (deny_unknown_fields: an unknown parameter is 400). Text filters are trimmed and compared case-insensitively; an empty value means no filter.

limit.description: Out of range is 400, never clamped.

error_type.description: Items whose error_types contain this value.

q.description: Substring of item_id, source_preview or translated_preview.

TranslationDebugListItemView.description: views/translation.rs :: TranslationDebugListItemView. Every key is always present; missing values are empty strings, empty arrays, -1 (block_idx) or true (should_translate).

block_idx.description: -1 when the page payload has none.

source_preview.description: Whitespace collapsed, at most 220 characters (cut with …).

page_path.description: The page file path as written in translation-manifest.json (normally relative to translated/, e.g. page-1.json).

item.description: The item exactly as stored in the page payload (source_text, translated_text, protected_translated_text, translation_diagnostics, ...), with secrets from the job request redacted. Not a stable schema.

payload.description: What replay_translation_item.py printed, with secrets redacted. Today: job_root, job_id, item_id, page_idx, page_path, source_preview, saved_item, policy_before, policy_after, replay_result (null when the item is not translated or the model call failed), replay_error ({type, message} when the model call failed, else null; a failed model call is still 200). A devtools payload, not a stable schema.

TranslationRevisionSource.description: Who produced the revision. Recorded only; it does not change validation.

translated_text.description: New translation in the same form as the item's protected_translated_text. In direct_typst math mode this is the display text with inline math as $...$; in placeholder mode formulas may be written back verbatim and are re-protected before validation.

expected_generation.description: Optimistic concurrency: the checkpoint generation the caller last saw. A mismatch returns 409 generation_mismatch with current_generation.

rerender.description: After a successful write, submit an in-place render retry (same as POST retry-stage {stage: render, create_new_job: false}). When revising several blocks, set it only on the last one or call retry-stage once afterwards.

kind.description: review_translation_item issue kind, e.g. empty_translation, math_delimiter_unbalanced, unexpected_placeholder, placeholder_inventory_mismatch, english_residue, mixed_english_residue, protocol_shell_output, truncated_translation, context_bleed, formula_commands_dropped, glossary_term_missing.

passed.description: False when any error-severity issue exists; warnings never block.

translation_unit_id.description: Group units start with __cg__:; revising one member rebuilds the whole unit's text, possibly on other pages.

translated_text.description: Display text after restoring protected tokens.

generation.description: Translation checkpoint generation after this revision.

page_hashes.description: Rewritten page payload file name -> sha256, equal to the checkpoint's page_hash.

status.description: published: this request registered the page and appended a commit event; current: already registered; superseded: a newer revision or translation is already registered; running_attempt: the page belongs to a running pipeline attempt whose worker will commit it; no_durable_attempt: the job has no durable translation record.

generation.description: Live-translation generation of the page row (what the live page snapshot and the commit event carry), not the checkpoint generation.

TranslationRevisionLivePublication.description: Registration of the revised pages in the live-translation read model (database). The page files and the checkpoint are authoritative and are never rolled back because registration failed.

status.description: published: at least one page was registered with its new page_hash and a translation_units_committed event was appended; current: nothing left to register; pending: a running attempt owns the page; unavailable: the job has no durable translation record, so live translation cannot show it anyway; failed: registration failed (see error). The write-back already took effect; resending the same request (changed=false) or reopening live translation registers it.

changed.description: False when text and status were already identical; nothing is written and generation does not move.

rerender.description: The retry-stage submission (job_id, source_job_id, status, workflow=render, rerun_from_stage, links, ...) when rerender=true and the render was queued; null otherwise.

rerender_error.description: Why the requested rerender could not be queued. The write-back itself has already been committed.
